audience: sales teams who track deals, people and companies in Pipeline CRM

useCases.title: Summarize your pipeline by deal stage
useCases.text: The AI reads the count and total value of deals in every stage, and the stage and pipeline lists, so you get a clear pipeline summary.

useCases.title: Find open deals expected to close soon
useCases.text: The AI lists deals filtered by status, owner, stage, value range or expected close date, with value and probability, so you see what may close this month.

useCases.title: Find a contact and read their notes and deals
useCases.text: The AI searches people by name, email or company, then lists their notes and the deals they are linked to.

useCases.title: Create or update a deal, update a person, add a company
useCases.text: The AI creates a deal with owner, stage, value and expected close date, moves a deal to another stage, updates a person, or creates a company.

useCases.title: Add notes, create tasks or events, or complete tasks
useCases.text: The AI adds a note to a deal, person or company, creates a task or event, or marks a task done.
